slices.focus: After a dialysis access-site scare, Kelli and her brother formalize a caregiving rotation with transport and paperwork split.
slices.summary: Gary has a dialysis access-site infection scare that creates extra appointments, forcing Kelli and her brother to formalize a caregiving rotation. They split transport from paperwork/callback ownership and use a paper calendar plus text thread for coordination. The household atmosphere eases — Travis can plan evenings better, and the marriage feels less strained because the uncertainty around caregiving drops.
